inlines.v: RIGHTNESS, noun 1. Correctness; conformity to truth or to the divine will, which is the standard of moral rectitude. It is important that a man should have such persuasion of the rightness of his conscience as to exclude rational doubt. 2. Straightness; as the rightness of a line.
